**plugin:** the native agent-plugin packages are removed. `.claude-plugin/`, `.codex-plugin/`, `.devin-plugin/`, `.grok-plugin/`, `.qoder-plugin/`, `.agents/plugins/`, `plugin.yaml`, `gemini-extension.json`, `package.json`, `opencode.json`, the OpenCode plugin, the distributed Pi extension and the generated rule files are gone, with `gen-plugin-assets.sh` and the release machinery that versioned them. Pixel reaches an agent through `pixel setup` alone.
